messages:
Samira: Heads up — 10:02 UTC EU edge read timeouts caused a burst of immediate SSE reconnects. quota panels spiked.
Ben G.: Console trace: proxy read_timeout -> clients open new streams with zero jitter.
Tao Li: Repro log:
`proxy.eu1 read_timeout=30000 session=aa3`
`client reconnect start`
ops-oncall: Two customers hit emergency throttles. Need short-term smoothing.
Samira: Proposal: emit a `_soft_hint` SSE event before closing with retry_ms hint, and tag telemetry `reconnect_hint=soft`.
Ben G.: Also emit `X-Stream-Hint` header for non-SSE consumers. Add `client_applied_hint=true/false` to resume logs.
Tao Li: I'll implement feature-flagged rollouts (10/30/70/100%) and add per-route console toggle + histograms for hinted vs forced reconnects.
ops-oncall: SDKs must parse `_soft_hint` and jitter; otherwise fallback: server-side delayed-accept for same IP.
deploy-bot: branch sse-soft-hint queued (CI passed) :rocket:
Samira: Action items: Tao proxy PR, Ben SDK PR, ops update alerts to suppress short hinted spikes. Ping #incidents if noisy during rollout.
